{{Quote|I am Representative Omana Tragg of the Isen Four mining colony. The fool who surrendered to the Empire.|Omana Tragg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Omana Tragg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who was the Representative of the [[Isen Four mining colony|mining colony]] located on [[Isen IV]] asteroid during the [[Galactic War]]. He willingly surrendered the colony to the representatives of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but was met with hostilities nonetheless. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] Agent [[Cipher Nine]] later discovered that the massacre in the colony was in fact caused not by the Empire, but by [[Star Cabal]] Agent [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]], who was pitting the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against each other while pretending to play for both sides as suitable. <!--voiced by kristoffer taboori-->
